records.title: Vision-OPD: Learning to See Fine Details for Multimodal LLMs via On-Policy Self-Distillation
records.reason: The paper studies regional-to-global self-distillation to improve fine-grained visual understanding; it removes inference-time visual tools by training the model, but does not introduce inference cost, memory, throughput, serving, or cache optimization.

records.title: OpenAgents: An Open Platform for Language Agents in the Wild
records.reason: OpenAgents describes a user-facing platform for deploying language agents and applications; no concrete optimization of LLM inference resources is its contribution.

records.title: Foundation Model for Advancing Healthcare: Challenges, Opportunities and Future Directions
records.reason: This is a healthcare foundation-model review organized around healthcare challenges and applications, not an LLM inference-system technique.

records.title: Analyzing Transformers in Embedding Space
records.reason: The work analyzes transformer representations in embedding space; it is interpretability/analysis, not a computational or serving improvement.

records.title: An Introduction to Neural Data Compression
records.reason: This tutorial surveys neural data compression and information-theoretic/image-compression methods, not compressing or serving LLM inference.
